title: Onboarding response
description: 201 response to POST /api/v1/onboarding (DEC-17, modelled on RFC 8628). The installer shows the user code and the verification URI, then polls POST /api/v1/onboarding/token with the device code.

device_code.description: Secret known only to the installer, used to poll for the credential. Never logged and never shown to a person.

user_code.description: Short code the operator confirms against the terminal. Identifies the request; grants nothing on its own.

verification_uri.description: Dashboard page where an operator enters the user code.

verification_uri_complete.description: Same page with the user code filled in, for a link or QR code.

interval.description: Minimum seconds between polls. Polling faster gets 429.
